dedupe_keys.name: arcgis industrial road topology and blockage preparation workflow

description: This repository documents an ArcGIS Pro workflow for preparing industrial access roads for routing analysis. It defines road and junction feature classes, checks overlaps, intersections and endpoint geometry, and records gates and other blockages that may limit route availability. The public tree contains arcpy scripts for road-geometry checks and blockage analysis, plus a topology guide. A modeller could use the checks to prepare a Network Dataset before simulating vehicle access or a disrupted industrial logistics route. The repository does not include the underlying road geodatabase; screenshots are illustrations, not reusable network records. Its topology guide warns that errors require manual review and correction after validation. This review checked the README, guide and file tree but did not run ArcGIS or verify a network. GitHub metadata says MIT for project code, while ArcGIS Pro and source asset data require separate rights. Geographic coverage is one unspecified industrial setting, not a national road network. Related resources would be the site’s actual road and blockage layers.
licence: MIT for repository scripts and documentation; ArcGIS Pro runtime requires separate access.
